title: Beckwith Country House
description:
Relax with the whole family at this peaceful place to stay in the country. Just east of Nashville this house is well positioned for easy access to everything in central Tennessee. Only a few miles from Percy Priest and Old Hickory lakes, Nashville Super Speedway, The Grand Ole Opry, Wilson County State Fair, and everything in downtown Nashville.

Whether you need a house for a month or two while waiting for your new home or taking that bucket list Nashville vacation, this house is for you.
